venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 3/11.** Steady night: a large party early and steady walk-ins; bar top mostly sat; after dinner the room picked up with plenty of dates and large parties incl. a 7-top at 44, a 7-top at 300 and an 8-top in the 30s at once. Last guests in by 10:30, last call about an hour later, emptied by midnight. Kitchen: over 14% of sales; plenty of multi-course tables; only the bikini sandwich 86'd. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: Great night! rainy at the very end
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 3/11.** Private event night: closed to the public, two events ('great turn of events'), packed with standing room only and hard to move across the room; staff ran drinks to guests so they did not need the bar. Told guests the classic D&C experience would be very different. Report shows $20,750 event sales; no food/beverage split, guest count or check average entered. Door: closed for a private event; three reservations made for Thursday 3/12 (Pete Crawley, Macallan rep, 2 @ 6pm; Steve Foster, 2 @ 6pm, Denver D&C patrons; Jane, local neighbor, 4 @ 8pm). Kitchen: good job team.
